$meta.purpose: Family-regex manifest + core-scope + judgment protocol for the [F-1] zero-core-branch falsifier. The core / common dispatch path must reach plugins ONLY through the capability registry + plugin interface, NEVER via an `if RVV` / `if IME` / `if Sophgo` family-name branch. This manifest lists each family's dispatch-key tokens and pins the CORE control-flow file scope; the checker greps the family keys over that scope and, per the judgment protocol below, flags a hit RED iff it is a family-name-keyed control-flow DECISION (if / switch / StringSwitch / starts_with / == on a family key). Declared false-positive classes (comments, mnemonics, dialect-type refs, registration tables, identity comparisons) are NOT branches and are NOT RED.
$meta.gate_semantics: RED iff any core line is a family-name-keyed control-flow/dispatch decision (a real I3 violation) that is not an allow-listed declared false-positive. GREEN == zero family-keyed branch in core (the invariant holds).
$meta.head_status: GREEN — zero family-keyed branch across 61 core files (re-verified 2026-07-12)

core_scope.note: CORE control flow = the common dispatch / selection / lowering that is family-AGNOSTIC. It EXCLUDES a family's own directory (lib/{Dialect,Conversion,Plugin,Target}/<Family>/ and its include/ mirror), where the family legitimately names itself. `recursive` roots pull all .cpp/.h/.td below them minus `exclude_subdir_names`; `depth1` roots pull only files directly in the directory (this naturally excludes lib/Plugin/<Family>/ etc.). lib/Conversion/EmitC/Builtin is INTENTIONALLY in scope: it is the zero-core-branch backend registration table (all families registered uniformly, iterated with no `if`).

judgment_protocol.authority: .trellis/spec/canon/能力模型与插件协议.md §二 [F-1] (判读规程)
judgment_protocol.red_condition: A core line is RED iff it is a family-name-keyed control-flow / dispatch DECISION: a family dispatch-key used as the discriminator of if / switch / StringSwitch(.Case) / starts_with / consume_front / contains / equals / == / != (string-literal family key), OR a bareword family enum in a switch/case/comparison (case RVV: / == Family::IME).
declared_false_positive_classes: 1. string literal in a data/table/registration line (family name as data, not a branch) — e.g. the kBuiltinBackendEmitters[] registration table entries.
2. identity comparison by origin (candidate.origin == selectedRoute.originPlugin) — equality on an origin value, not a hardcoded family-name discriminator.

3. op-attribute name / type mnemonic / pass mnemonic containing a family substring (weft_rvv.* type, `weft-rvv-lower-to-emitc` pass name, `::weft::rvv::WEFTRVVDialect` dependent-dialect ref) — naming, not a decision.
4. comments / documentation strings (including self-documenting 'does not branch on RVV, IME, ...' pass summaries).

5. a family key passed as a DATA argument to a family-agnostic function (impliedClosureAvoidsNamespace(seed, "rvv") — the F-6 independence-ENFORCEMENT mechanism; the generic function compares against its parameter, not a hardcoded family literal).
judgment_protocol.allow_list_rule: New declared false-positives that would otherwise trip the branch detector must be registered EXPLICITLY in `allow_list` as a precise (file_glob, regex) pair (RFC-marked commit). The global family regex is never widened to hide a hit. A branch-construct hit not covered by allow_list = RED.
